text:
The 1960 deed gave the friend a fee simple subject to a shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25. That interest is void under the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities: a child born late in the sister’s life can turn 25 more than 21 years after her death, and church use can occur at any later time, so the interest is not certain to vest within lives in being plus 21 years. The void gift is stricken and the friend holds fee simple absolute; the later births and deaths leave that result unchanged.

CONFIDENCE: 90
